_comment: Demo-grade static sustainability scores per shop domain. 0-100, higher = more sustainable. Hand-curated, very basic by design — NOT a certification feed; notes are one-line summaries. Shops missing here are reported as 'unknown' by lib/sustainability.js, never guessed.

digitec.ch.note: published sustainability report, repairability pledge, e-waste take-back

galaxus.ch.note: digitec Galaxus marketplace; sustainability report, second-life/returns programme

galaxus.de.note: Galaxus DE; sustainability report, second-life programme

brack.ch.note: family-run Allgäu retailer; efficient logistics, e-waste take-back

decathlon.ch.note: eco-design programme, spare-parts & repair offer, published product scorecards

ochsnersport.ch.note: sports retailer; some sustainable product lines, moderate public reporting

microspot.ch.note: Coop Group; some eco ranges, moderate reporting

intersport.ch.note: retailer co-op; some eco ranges, thin public reporting

hm.com.note: garment collecting, reported sustainability data; record contested by critics

zalando.ch.note: fashion platform; some sustainable ranges, packaging reductions

interdiscount.ch.note: discount electronics; limited public sustainability reporting

sportxx.ch.note: budget sports chain (Coop Group); limited sustainability data
